question.problem:
Consider the absolute value equation 

$$
8-|4x+5|=1.
$$

This equation can be expressed in the following equivalent form:

$|4x+5|=$
{{field-1}}
question.worked_solution:
We can rearrange the equation to isolate the absolute value on the left side:

First, we subtract $8$ from both sides of the equation:

$$
\begin{aligned}8-|4x+5|=1 \\ 8-|4x+5|-8=1-8 \\ -|4x+5|=-7\end{aligned}
$$

Then, we multiply both sides of the equation by $-1:$

$$
\begin{aligned}-|4x+5| & =-7 \\ (-1)\cdot (-|4x+5|) & =(-1)\cdot (-7) \\ (\cancel{-}1)\cdot (\cancel{-}|4x+5|) & =7 \\ |4x+5| & =7\end{aligned}
$$
